chunks: 20 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers, from 'Ali عليه السلام:
That the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when he entered the mosque while Bilal was commencing the iqamah for the salat (prayer), sat down.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the salat (prayer), here referring to the congregational prayer
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدَ: the mosque, the place of congregational worship
key_terms.بِلَالٌ: Bilal, the mu'adhdhin associated here with commencing the iqamah
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: was giving the iqamah, initiating the call that the salat (prayer) is about to begin

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم do when he entered the mosque while Bilal was giving the iqamah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a practice of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم related to entering the mosque at the time of the iqamah. It indicates a specific prophetic manner in connection with congregational salat (prayer) and mosque conduct.
